name: Kelleys Island, Ohio
description: Events from the history of Kelleys Island, Lake Erie: the Kelley brothers, quarrying, wine making, the Civil War, and more. Written as a starting point: check the facts, and add your own.

events.title: Quarrying begins
events.text: John Clemens and his brother begin quarrying limestone on the north shore of the island.

events.title: Kelley brothers buy the island
events.text: Datus and Irad Kelley begin buying land on the island, for its limestone and timber.
events.note: Check: One source gives 1836 for the purchase.

events.title: Kelleys Island named
events.text: The island, until then called Cunningham Island, is organized as a township and renamed Kelleys Island. It has 68 residents.

events.title: Wine making begins
events.text: Grape growing and wine making begin on the island. By the early 1900s dozens of wineries operate there.
events.note: Check: Sources say the 1840s; 1842 is the date most often given.

events.title: American Civil War
events.text: Confederate officers are held as prisoners on Johnson's Island, in Sandusky Bay a few miles from Kelleys Island, from 1862 until the end of the war.

events.title: Raid on Lake Erie
events.text: Confederate raiders seize the steamer Philo Parsons near Kelleys Island, in a plot to free the prisoners on Johnson's Island. The plot fails.
events.note: Check: Sources differ on exactly where the steamer was seized.

events.title: Lime and Transport Company formed
events.text: The Kelleys Island Lime & Transport Company is formed, and runs many of the island's quarries.
events.note: Check: One source says the quarries were consolidated in 1891 instead.

events.title: Kelleys Island becomes a village
events.text: Kelleys Island is incorporated as a village.

events.title: Glacial grooves preserved
events.text: A section of quarry land is set aside to save one of the last glacial grooves, carved into the island's limestone during the last ice age.

events.title: Great Lakes storm
events.text: A fierce storm, later called the White Hurricane, wrecks many ships and kills more than 250 sailors across the Great Lakes.

events.title: World War I
events.text: The United States takes part in the First World War.

events.title: Prohibition
events.text: The sale of alcohol is banned across the United States, a blow to the island's wine makers.
events.note: Check: The effect on the island wine makers is likely, but find a local source.

events.title: World War II
events.text: The United States takes part in the Second World War.

events.title: Quarrying ends
events.text: Most of the island's quarries have closed by about 1940.

events.title: State park opens
events.text: Kelleys Island State Park is established. It includes the ruins of old lime kilns and quarries.
